title: Dynamic Market Timing in Mutual Funds
authors: Jeffrey A. Busse; Jing Ding; Lei Jiang; Ke Wu
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Table 5 uses the Regulation SHO pilot window (2005-05 to 2007-07), a single common date.
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. The paper estimates daily DCC fund betas and market-timing coefficients (portfolio sorts, cross-sectional and panel regressions, bootstrap). The only DiD (Table 5) is xtreg gamma time rsho did, fe with a common Reg SHO pilot window (2005-05 to 2007-07) and a continuous exposure (rsho = share of holdings in pilot stocks), no time FE; the input data (rfsho2020.dta, fund_2019.dta) are not shipped.
design_notes: Stata and R (DCC/ADCC/BEKK/CCC GARCH estimation). Tables 1-4: timing estimates and downside-risk sorts; Table 6: derivative use; Tables 7-8: persistence and flows.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common date (Reg SHO pilot), continuous exposure (rsho), no calendar-time FE; Table 5 cols 3-4 add time-varying fund controls

data_files_note: Ships Fama-French factors, daily portfolio returns and estimated beta/timing outputs; CRSP/Thomson fund data and the Reg SHO holdings file (rfsho2020.dta) are proprietary and not shipped.
data_provenance_note: Data for the only DiD-type table (Table 5) are not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Asset-pricing paper; no staggered design.
